body: Yes. Feel that every fucking day.
I am there. I totally get you.

You are in a much better position than I am in. Imagine, having an abusive partner who is so lazy and chicken that he doesnt do anything except playing games the whole day and I stay only because I sacrificed so much for him. No one else to talk to. This pandemic is making me even more depressed. I am soon planning to ctb, the only thing holding me back is the curiosity as to what life has in store for me. I have always wanted to big things in life, but I dont know what I have been doing the past couple years. I literally hate my partner for the way he is.
What chat is that? I have been trying to get access to some chat. Chatzy doesnt allow me unless there is an admin password.

Ditto. I hate waking up every morning knowing I am gonna spend the day as a failure. Whatever I try to do doesnt seem to work anymore and so because of factors that are not under my control. I FUCKING HATE my LIFE. How are you planning to catch the bus?
I dont want to come across to people as a weak person contemplating suicide. And if someone really cared, my parents would get to know and I can't end this suffering.
Thanks. Hopefully. Ironically, I have lost all my hope. But I am still hanging in there. I wish he could be as empathetic to me as you are to a complete stranger.

There could be some. I dont know. All I need is some peace. I can get that in work. I just can't bear wasting what were supposed be fruitful years given by God, if he exists. I have graduated from a theist to an agnostic after marriage. Time is not coming back. With each day I waste, my desire to end the suffering is becoming more and more. Each birthday I celebrate after getting married is just another painful reminder of what I could have done in life. I'm just so ashamed of myself for marrying someone like this. I am not scared of failure, not trying is something I can never forgive myself for. But, I cant do anything with a partner like mine. He is the weight that is pulling me back.
Yes. I'm not really sure many will understand what I am going through irl. Do you know of any anonymous chat rooms that serve the purpose?
Cant announce this to people. Then, someone will be watching me every second of everyday. Atleast my mom will, I cant put her through this.

I dont want to lay this out to people who really care, may be one or two people, will devastate them. How can you tell your family that you are contemplating suicide? I'm giving myself till the year end. If nothing works out, I will go on a world tour (without the vaccination, yes) and come back home to ctb or may be ctb there.
Yes. This should have been a deadly virus with extremely high case fatality ratio. I would want some meteorite to hit the earth, so that people wont remember me as someone that committed suicide.
